meta.name: Renegade Nell
meta.description: England, 1705: Framed for murder and on the run with her sisters, Nell Jackson turns her hand to highway robbery to survive. Aided by her superpowered sidekick, a plucky little sprite called Billy Blind, Nell realizes that fate has put her on the wrong side of the law for a reason. A reason much bigger than she could have ever imagined: to defeat a magical plot against the Queen of England.

videos.title: Don't Call Me "Nelly"
videos.overview: England, 1705: Nell Jackson's supernatural fighting skills stir up trouble on her return from war.

videos.title: Tracks Less Well Trod
videos.overview: On the run from the law, Nell, Roxy and George turn to highway robbery to survive.

videos.title: A Private Joke with the Queen
videos.overview: Poynton's dark magic catches up with Nell. One of her sisters is dangerously wounded in the escape.

videos.title: Devil's Dung
videos.overview: Nell risks capture to find a doctor, and the gang receive help from some unlikely sources.

videos.title: Excuse Me, I'm a Doctor
videos.overview: Nell goes to Newgate Prison to try and rescue Devereux, and Roxy and George meet their Uncle Jack.

videos.title: Snatched by Strollers
videos.overview: Nell sets out to rescue George, and Rasselas finally confronts Sofia.

videos.title: Stop Printing This Muck
videos.overview: The gang head to Fleet Street to stop the news sheets from printing lies about Nell.

videos.title: Not Some Cheap Trick
videos.overview: Nell and the gang race against time to stop Poynton and save the Queen.

meta.slogan: She's a bit of a legend.
